title: Tiny, cute wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Watch band top -->
  <rect x='40' y='6' width='20' height='22' rx='4' fill='#e05a5a'/>
  <!-- Watch band bottom -->
  <rect x='40' y='72' width='20' height='22' rx='4' fill='#e05a5a'/>
  <!-- Band stitching top -->
  <rect x='46' y='10' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#f5b0a0'/>
  <rect x='46' y='17' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#f5b0a0'/>
  <!-- Band stitching bottom -->
  <rect x='46' y='80' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#f5b0a0'/>
  <rect x='46' y='87' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#f5b0a0'/>
  <!-- Buckle -->
  <rect x='38' y='40' width='24' height='8' rx='2' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <rect x='46' y='41' width='8' height='6' rx='1' fill='#e05a5a'/>
  <!-- Watch case -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='26' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <!-- Face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='21' fill='#fdf6e3'/>
  <!-- Inner ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='17' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#e8a838' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Hour markers -->
  <rect x='49' y='30' width='2' height='5' rx='1' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <rect x='49' y='65' width='2' height='5' rx='1' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <rect x='30' y='49' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <rect x='65' y='49' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <!-- Cute face eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='47' r='2.5' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='47' r='2.5' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M44 55 Q50 60 56 55' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Hour hand -->
  <rect x='49' y='38' width='2' height='12' rx='1' fill='#4a4a8a' transform='rotate(-30 50 50)'/>
  <!-- Minute hand -->
  <rect x='49' y='34' width='2' height='16' rx='1' fill='#c0392b' transform='rotate(60 50 50)'/>
  <!-- Center dot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='3' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <!-- Crown -->
  <rect x='74' y='47' width='5' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#e8a838'/>
  <!-- Cute rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='53' r='2.5' fill='#f7a8a8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='53' r='2.5' fill='#f7a8a8' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
